Select the first 1000 activity rows for IC50 assays against human single-protein target CHEMBL1250412 (Transient receptor potential cation channel subfamily M member 7). Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', and pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Order by molecule_chembl_id, then assay_chembl_id. Do not deduplicate rows.
